title: TestOrphansV1
description: What keeps a `bun test` process from outliving its runner or the host: the child side (a preload) caps the open files of the process and ends its whole tree when its parent is gone; the runner side counts the open files of the process tree of a test file, stops it above the cap by name and, when the file is over, ends and names every process it left behind.

en.parentGone: [tests] the runner of this test process ({parent}) is gone: ending process {pid} and everything it started
en.descriptors: [tests] {file} holds {count} open files in process {pid} ({command}) and was stopped at its ceiling of {ceiling} open files
en.orphans: [tests] {file} left {count} process(es) running after it ended; they were stopped: {list}
